- Iterate i from 0 to n-1, selecting those where i % 11 == 0 or i % 13 == 0.
- For each selected i, convert to string and count occurrences of '7' (or repeatedly divide by 10 to count digit 7), accumulating a total.
- Return the accumulated count; handle n <= 0 by returning 0 (loop naturally yields 0).
